thread.title: Apple Group FaceTime feature, What’s Get Wrong in it???

author: Marcelle Iacocca
title: Apple Group FaceTime feature, What’s Get Wrong in it???
text:
February 3, 2019 Apple Group FaceTime feature, What’s Get Wrong in it???
Why the tech company, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has not revealed the bug in it Group Facetime feature? because company is afraid of its user’s response. The iPhone users, who are looking to use the Group FaceTime feature, up till now won’t be able to just yet.
The reason behind it because Apple is constantly delaying its fix for a bug, on the app, that allowed the eavesdroppers to listen in on calls, and even to see through the front-facing cameras.
In this week, reportedly a software update will be rolled out to address the issue with FaceTime feature but according to 9to5Mac, the company is intentionally pushing it back.
“We have fixed the Group FaceTime security bug on Apple’s servers and we will issue a software update to re-enable the feature for users next week,” it said in a statement to the outlet. “We sincerely apologize to our customers who were affected and all who were concerned about this security issue.”
After the issue was reported, Apple Inc noted that it disabled Group FaceTime feature on app, and the bug had obviously impacted both iPhones and iPads, running 12.1.2 as well as with the Apple PCs with the macOS Mojave, according to CNN reports. About Marcelle Iacocca
